fact: BoFiNet's Integrated Report 2025 (financial year to 31 March 2025) states Botswana has 3 international submarine cable systems, EASSy, WACS and Equiano, and that BoFiNet manages EASSy and WACS international cable access; no landing stations or neighbours are named.

Botswana's National Broadband Strategy (June 2018) states Botswana is connected to two submarine cables, EASSy and WACS, with the submarine cable landing stations reached through Namibia and South Africa, two different neighbouring countries.

BoFiNet (Botswana Fibre Networks) announced on 2026-09-23 a long-term international capacity lease with an unnamed South African partner, raising its available international capacity through the Ramatlabama and Pioneer Gate border crossings (both into South Africa) from 300 Gbit/s to 1 Tbit/s; two crossings, one neighbour, so not independent.
system: BoFiNet international links via Ramatlabama and Pioneer Gate (South Africa)
